test_McNemar: test the McNemar class to compare two classifiers using predictions and ground truth labels
run_McNemar_compute: run the McNemar _compute method to calculate the chi-squared statistic and p-value from paired predictions
build_McNemar_info: build the McNemar _info method to return comparison metadata including features, description, and citation
review_McNemar: review the McNemar class that performs McNemar's test on a contingency table of two classifier predictions
summarize_McNemar: summarize the McNemar test that evaluates whether two classifiers differ significantly on the same reference labels
